subject: Post-demo token economics deep dive & next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-02-21T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo token economics deep dive & next steps

Hi Jamie / Linh —

Thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and the data points we need to finalize a pricing proposal and next steps for a pilot. I captured the items below from our conversation — please confirm or correct inline.

Summary of needs (as I heard them)
- Primary use: real-time patient summary generation and clinician notes ingestion for analytics.
- Typical prompt: clinical context + patient history + instructions. Typical completion: 1–2 paragraphs with structured JSON output for downstream storage.

Requested profiling data (please confirm):
- Avg prompt tokens (mean): ~1,200 tokens per request
- Avg completion tokens (mean): ~450 tokens per request
- Token mix: roughly 73% prompt / 27% completion by token volume (we used above means)
- Monthly throughput target: 150M total tokens (prompt + completion) with 20k–30k requests/day peak
- Context length needs: primarily 8k context for live notes; ~5% of requests need 32k (full-encounter histories); ~1% need 128k (bulk export processing)

Pricing target you mentioned on the call: $/1M tokens goal of around $800 (you said finance is comfortable in the $700–$900 range). Please confirm if that is still accurate.

Attachments: I attached a starter spreadsheet (greenline-token-profile.xlsx) with a simple token-by-workflow worksheet — fill in any finer-grained counts (bursts per hour, percent of long-context requests) and return.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the per-request averages and monthly target numbers in the attached sheet.
2) We produce two priced scenarios (hosted, and dedicated/reserved capacity) showing unit $/1M token and estimated monthly spend for: (a) baseline (8k-only) and (b) mixed contexts (8k + 32k + 128k).
3) If numbers look good, schedule a 30-min pricing review w/ your finance and our commercial AE — propose Thu Feb 25 or Fri Feb 26.

If you want a quick worked example in the sheet, we can add an assumed retention/window for KV cache to show cost reductions for repeated prompts.

Thanks — I’ll start a draft pricing plan as soon as you confirm the token averages.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: greenline-token-profile.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34 KB)

Subject: Re: Post-demo token economics deep dive & next steps

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers below — these are our current estimates from the product team and infra forecasting:
- Avg prompt tokens: 1,150–1,300 (we used 1,200 as a midpoint)
- Avg completion tokens: 400–500 (we build for 450)
- Monthly target: 150M tokens (prompt+completion) with the ability to spike to ~220M in month-end batch processing windows
- Context breakdown: ~94% of requests will be within 8k; ~5% will hit 32k; ~1% will be 128k for archival exports
- Our internal target price: $700–$900 per 1M tokens for pilot (aiming for $800). We can be flexible on a short pilot if there is a committed usage window.

We filled the token-profile sheet with the daily/weekly splits and uploaded it to the Drive link you provided. See row "GLH-rough-forecast" in the sheet.

Two quick asks: can you provide a rough monthly cost table (hosted vs dedicated) using the 8k-only vs mixed-context assumptions? And can you show how KV caching would reduce costs if we have many repeated prompts per patient?

Happy to lock a Thu/ Fri slot — Thu Feb 25 at 9:30am PT works for us if available.

—Jamie
Jamie Cole
Director, Platform Engineering | Greenline Health

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-02-21T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo token economics deep dive & next steps

Jamie — great, thanks for the upload and confirmation. Below is a concise worked example so your finance team can see order-of-magnitude spend. I assume the $/1M token target you quoted ($800) for the pilot unless you tell us otherwise.

Scenario A — Baseline (8k context only, no long-context processing)
- Monthly tokens: 150M
- Unit price: $800 per 1M tokens (pilot target)
- Monthly cost = 150 * $800 / 1 = $120,000

Scenario B — Mixed context (8k primary; 5% 32k; 1% 128k)
- Effective token inflation: longer contexts increase token counts per request; using your sheet, adjusted monthly tokens become ~175M total after accounting for longer contexts and batch export overhead
- Unit price: $800 per 1M tokens
- Monthly cost = 175 * $800 = $140,000

Notes on optimizations and options
- KV/prefix caching: if you have repeated prompts per patient (e.g., templated items + stable history), we typically see 10–35% token savings for completion-facing workloads. If caching cuts tokens 20% on applicable workflows, Scenario B effective monthly tokens drop to ~150M and monthly spend drops to ~$120k.

Hosted vs Dedicated (high level)
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): simple to start, predictable unit pricing; good for pilots and early production. Lower operational lift.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): requires commit, gives improved unit economics at scale and consistent latency for heavy throughput — typical break-even around 400–600M tokens/month depending on model family and context mix. We will run a dedicated quote if you expect to scale above those ranges.

Deliverables we will share before Thu 2027-02-25 9:30am PT meeting:
- Redwood pricing proposal (PDF) with a clean comparison table (hosted vs dedicated) and pilot discount options (attached as redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf)
- Worked examples in the Drive sheet showing token-by-workflow and KV caching sensitivity

If the $800/1M pilots looks too high for finance, tell us the target we should price to (e.g., $700 flat) and we can present a tailored pilot that includes a short-term usage commitment in exchange for that rate.

I’ve attached the proposal and included a short cost sensitivity table on page 2. Let us know any changes and we’ll iterate. See you Thu — I’ll send the calendar invite.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

2) Please include an explicit line showing the cost impact if KV caching reduces applicable tokens by 20%.

If you can include those two items in an updated one-page proposal, we can escalate to procurement during the Thu meeting and aim to sign a pilot SOW the same week.

I’m good with the 9:30am PT slot — calendar invite would be great.

—Jamie
